name: Oomori Tomoka
source:
She is quiet but possesses a strong sense of self. An ordinary young woman attending a university near the train line. Her hobbies are photography and admiring beautiful things.

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023222235/http://www.bishoge.jp/scoop/products/museum/yuwaku.htm]ScooP archived page[/url]]
